messages:
sara-sales: Hey team, POC with a EU customer. They report model not found when requesting rw-large-2024 in eu-west1. Getting 404: "model not available in region". Also seeing intermittent 429s during burst tests.
ian-se: Thanks Sara — can you paste a req id and the exact API call? region used? customer account id?
sara-sales: Req id: req_0a7f3b2c, called /v1/generate with model="rw-large-2024" and region="eu-west1". Account: cust-43321. Example response: `{
  "error": "model_not_available_in_region",
  "message": "Requested model is not deployed in eu-west1"
}`
mike-eng: Hmm, rw-large-2024 was a staged rollout. In EU we only have rw-large-2024-quant or rw-medium-2024 pinned. Could be the model variant isn't mirrored. Are they pinning to the exact model id?
sara-sales: They used the friendly name from our catalog page. I asked them to try "rw-large-2024-quant" and they still got 404.
olivia-ps: Customer said they can't change model easily; they need feature parity. Also asking about pricing delta between quantized and full fp16.
mike-eng: For immediate unblock: 1) try specifying model by full version tag: `rw-large-2024@2024-11-12` 2) set fallback policy to a compatible model in EU: `fallback: ["rw-medium-2024"]` 3) if 429s persist, share client-side rate limit headers (x-rw-rate-limit-*).
sara-sales: Sent the suggested call with version tag. New req id: req_0a9c8d11. Response now is 403 with message "deprecated_model_version".
mike-eng: Okay that's different — looks like that specific version was deprecated last quarter. We should surface a migration path. Can you confirm which SDK client and version?
sara-sales: They're using python SDK 0.9.2 (pinned due to internal policies).
ian-se: SDK pin likely mapping friendly names to obsolete IDs. We should tell them to upgrade or override model field explicitly. Also share a temp workaround: hit hosted endpoint with `?model=rw-medium-2024` for EU testing.
infra-bot: deploy-status: mirror-job eu-west1 for rw-large-2024-quant queued (job id mirror-3321). ETA ~25m.
mike-eng: I'll open a quick support ticket to force mirror for this POC tenant (cust-43321) and add a temporary routing rule so their requests are routed to us-east fallback if policy allows.
olivia-ps: Can you include pricing note for quant vs full in the ticket? They asked pricing for cost forecast.
mike-eng: Will add: quantized variant ~30-40% fewer tokens CPU cost, but slight quality delta. Recommend eval with our evaluation harness.
sara-sales: Thanks. Also the 429s — they show bursts hitting ~120 rps then 429. They only have free-tier limits currently. Can we advise bump or test a dedicated burst?
i an-se: quick note: free-tier global quotas are lower in EU. Suggest temporary increase for cust-43321 to avoid throttling during POC. I'll request quota bump for 2 hours tomorrow at noon CET.
sara-sales: Appreciate it. I'll tell the customer the planned mirror + quota bump. Will update thread after their tests. :thumbsup:
